_comment: Shape A — a simulated overnight IBI + accel window from the Titan band. ibi_ms are inter-beat intervals (ms); accel_counts are per-minute activity counts (low = still = good HRV window). This is the cheapest, default band payload. Fed through POST /api/devices/ingest by `php artisan devices:simulate`. Window kind=ibi → persisted to the raw disk → ProcessWindowJob → biosignal /process/hrv → recovery_logs.hrv_ms.
